findings.claim: Gaps G3 and G5 have no build-vs-adopt evaluation: every candidate's fit_for_gap covers only G1, G2, and G4, yet gaps_addressed claims all of G1–G5 are addressed.
findings.evidence: fit_for_gap values: tokio-sync [G1,G4], harness-subagents [G1], process-workers [G1,G4], merge-threads [G1,G2], onyx-budgets [G4], onyx-parallel-cap [G1,G4], uar-native-runner [G1], workspace-split []. No candidate maps to G3 (stage 09 multi-pass report split) or G5 (benchmark harness). Both appear only in build_required ("Stage 09 split..." and "Benchmark harness reporting RACE..."), so the analysis silently defaults to BUILD for two of five goals without evaluating any adoptable alternative (e.g., an existing deep-research eval/RACE harness for G5, or an existing report-assembly/coherence pattern for G3).
findings.suggested_fix: Either add candidate entries for G3 and G5 with explicit verdicts (even if the verdict is 'build, no adoptable alternative exists, because X'), or narrow gaps_addressed to the gaps actually evaluated.

findings.claim: The analysis silently drops a question the assess handoff explicitly deferred to this stage: whether a D-B republish triggers the C-03 docs constraint.
findings.evidence: assess.handoff.json summaryForNext: "whether a D-B republish also triggers a docs constraint is deferred to analyze." analysis.md D-09 commits to fixing D-B in this phase ("Fix in this phase") but mentions only C-01 and C-05; the string "C-03" appears nowhere in analysis.md or library-candidates.json, and D-B's docs surface (docs/codex-plugin.md, CLAUDE.md Codex CLI section per constraint C-03) is never analyzed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a D-B row to §3 or the process-workers candidate risks stating whether republishing the driver touches the Codex plugin surface and therefore whether C-03 doc updates are required in the same change.

findings.claim: Open question 5 asserts a numeric Onyx constant ("caps intermediate reports at 10K with a comment that ~5K is empirically better") that appears nowhere in the verified-claims table of §1.1, in an artifact whose stated method is source verification of every load-bearing constant.
findings.evidence: §1.1 verifies MAX_FINAL_REPORT_TOKENS = 20000 (dr_loop.py:80) but contains no intermediate-report token cap entry; §4 item 5 introduces the 10K/~5K figures with no file:line citation. Given V4's rule that unverified numbers must not enter the plan as fact, this number could propagate unlabeled.
findings.suggested_fix: Either cite the Onyx source line for the intermediate cap and add it to the §1.1 table, or mark the 10K/~5K figures as unverified pending source confirmation.
